szoveg_eredeti:
Madison Mills / Axios :

 Dario Amodei rejects the idea of surrendering free will to AI and accuses rival AI execs of “vibes-based” positioning, rebutting a report on AI leaders' views   —  - Amodei distinguished between handing over governance to AI, which he opposes, and automating specific tasks, on which he holds more nuanced views.
